## MARKET SUMMARY

## INDIA

The Indian market has experienced downward pressure this week, primarily driven by a sharp depreciation of the INR against the USD, which has forced local price levels lower. Despite weaker underlying fundamentals, ship recycling sentiment remains cautiously positive, with recyclers showing resilience in expectations of near-term improvement.
